category: faq_general
question: How long does a screen repair take?
answer: Most screen repairs are completed the same day, often while you wait, depending on part availability. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm typical turnaround, e.g. 30-60 mins for common phone/laptop models].

category: faq_general
question: Do I need to book an appointment?
answer: You're welcome to walk in during opening hours, but booking ahead helps us make sure the part you need is in stock. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm if online booking exists].

category: faq_general
question: How much does a repair cost?
answer: Pricing depends on the device, model, and fault. Send us your device model and issue and we'll give you a quote. [PLACEHOLDER: add a price list or price-range table].

category: faq_general
question: Can you fix devices other than phones and laptops?
answer: Yes — we also repair tablets, desktop PCs, and Mac computers, plus offer data recovery and virus removal.

category: faq_general
question: Do you offer a while-you-wait service?
answer: Yes, E-Tech offers a while-you-wait service for many common repairs, subject to parts being in stock.

category: warranty_policy
question: How long is the repair warranty?
answer: [PLACEHOLDER: e.g. 'All repairs come with a 3-month warranty covering the part and workmanship.'] Please confirm exact warranty length with our team.

category: warranty_policy
question: What does the warranty cover?
answer: [PLACEHOLDER] Typically a repair warranty covers the specific part replaced and the workmanship of the repair — it does not usually cover new/unrelated damage, liquid damage after the repair, or accidental drops.

category: warranty_policy
question: What voids the warranty?
answer: [PLACEHOLDER] Common exclusions: opening the device elsewhere after repair, further physical/liquid damage, or software issues unrelated to the original repair.

category: warranty_policy
question: Do I need a receipt to claim warranty?
answer: Yes, please keep your repair receipt/invoice as proof of the repair date and work carried out.

category: repair_policy
question: What's covered in a screen repair?
answer: A screen repair covers replacement of the damaged screen/digitiser. It does not automatically cover other faults found during diagnosis (e.g. battery, charging port) unless agreed separately.

category: repair_policy
question: What's not covered by your repairs?
answer: Pre-existing issues unrelated to the reported fault, further accidental damage after collection, and cosmetic wear are generally not covered. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm exact exclusions].

category: repair_policy
question: Will you tell me if you find another problem while repairing?
answer: Yes — if we find an additional fault during diagnosis or repair, we'll contact you before carrying out any extra work or charging extra.

category: supported_devices
question: What brands of phones do you repair?
answer: We repair a wide range of smartphones including iPhone and Samsung, plus most Android brands. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm full brand list].

category: supported_devices
question: Do you repair laptops?
answer: Yes, we repair laptops from all major brands, including Apple MacBooks, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Asus, and Acer/Gateway.

category: supported_devices
question: Do you repair tablets?
answer: Yes, tablet repairs are one of our listed services.

category: supported_devices
question: Do you repair Apple/Mac products?
answer: Yes — we offer MacBook and Mac repairs, screen replacement, and data recovery.

category: repair_types
question: Do you fix cracked screens?
answer: Yes, screen and glass repairs/replacements are one of our core services for phones, laptops, and tablets.

category: repair_types
question: Do you replace batteries?
answer: Yes, battery replacement is available for phones and laptops. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm which models are supported].

category: repair_types
question: Can you fix a broken charging port?
answer: Yes, we repair charging/power jack ports on both phones and laptops.

category: repair_types
question: Can you fix water/liquid damage?
answer: Yes, liquid damage repair is one of our listed laptop repair services. Bring the device in as soon as possible and avoid turning it on.

category: repair_types
question: Do you unlock phones?
answer: Yes, mobile phone unlocking is one of our services.

category: repair_types
question: Do you build custom gaming PCs?
answer: Yes, gaming PC assembly is one of our listed services.

category: diagnostic_information
question: What happens when I bring my device in for diagnosis?
answer: Our technician inspects the device, identifies the fault, and gives you a quote and estimated repair time before any work begins. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm if diagnosis is free or has a fee].

category: diagnostic_information
question: Is diagnosis free?
answer: [PLACEHOLDER: confirm — many repair shops offer free diagnosis with no obligation to repair].

category: diagnostic_information
question: How long does diagnosis take?
answer: Most diagnostics can be done on the spot or within the same day. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm typical wait].

category: home_repair_policy
question: Do your technicians visit homes?
answer: [PLACEHOLDER: confirm — the listing mentions 'Home Computer Services', which may include home visits. Please verify with the shop whether on-site/home repair is offered and any callout fee.]

category: home_repair_policy
question: Can someone come to my office to fix my PC?
answer: [PLACEHOLDER: confirm on-site business support availability].

category: collection_delivery_policy
question: Can I post my device to you for repair?
answer: [PLACEHOLDER: confirm if E-Tech accepts mail-in repairs, or if it's in-store drop-off only at 26 Tooting High St, London SW17 0RG.]

category: collection_delivery_policy
question: Do you offer collection or delivery?
answer: [PLACEHOLDER: confirm pickup/delivery radius and any charges].

category: collection_delivery_policy
question: What condition will my device be returned in?
answer: Your device is returned cleaned and tested after repair, with the fault resolved and any replaced parts disposed of unless you request them back.

category: cancellation_policy
question: Can I cancel my repair booking?
answer: [PLACEHOLDER: confirm cancellation notice period and whether any deposit is refundable].

category: cancellation_policy
question: What if I decide not to go ahead after diagnosis?
answer: You're not obligated to proceed after diagnosis. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm if a diagnostic fee applies if you decline the repair].

category: refund_policy
question: Can I get a refund if the repair doesn't fix the issue?
answer: [PLACEHOLDER: confirm refund policy — typically the shop will re-attempt the repair first, then offer a refund/replacement part if it can't be resolved.]

category: refund_policy
question: Do you refund parts I don't want fitted?
answer: [PLACEHOLDER: confirm parts refund/exchange policy].

category: privacy_policy
question: Will you access my personal data on my device?
answer: We only access data on your device as needed to diagnose or repair the fault, and we recommend backing up and removing sensitive data beforehand. [PLACEHOLDER: link to a formal data protection/privacy statement if E-Tech has one.]

category: privacy_policy
question: Do you keep a copy of my data?
answer: [PLACEHOLDER: confirm data retention policy, especially for data recovery jobs].

category: opening_hours
question: Are you open today?
answer: We're open most days — check today's hours above, or call 07429 656565 to confirm.

category: opening_hours
question: Are you open on Sundays?
answer: Yes, we're open Sundays from 12:00 to 17:00.

category: shop_information
question: Where are you located?
answer: We're at 26 Tooting High St, London, SW17 0RG.

category: shop_information
question: What's your phone number?
answer: You can reach us on 07429 656565.

category: shop_information
question: How long have you been in business?
answer: E-Tech has been repairing devices for around 10 years and has a 4.6/5 rating from customer reviews.

category: general_service_description
question: What does E-Tech do?
answer: E-Tech is a computer and phone repair specialist offering laptop and desktop repairs, screen replacement, power jack repair, liquid damage repair, data recovery, virus removal, mobile unlocking, gaming PC builds, and Mac/MacBook repairs.

category: general_service_description
question: Are you specialists or a general repair shop?
answer: We're specialists — our team focuses specifically on device repair and offers competitive pricing and while-you-wait service where possible.

category: customer_preparation_instructions
question: Should I back up my phone before bringing it in?
answer: Yes, we recommend backing up your data beforehand, especially for repairs involving data recovery, screen, or motherboard work, in case data loss occurs during repair.

category: customer_preparation_instructions
question: Should I remove my SIM card?
answer: Yes, please remove your SIM card and memory card before dropping your phone off, unless the issue is related to the SIM tray itself.

category: customer_preparation_instructions
question: Should I remove my passcode or Find My iPhone/Google lock?
answer: Yes — please disable Find My iPhone / Google Find My Device and provide your passcode if needed so we can fully test the repair. We cannot complete some repairs without this.

category: customer_preparation_instructions
question: What should I bring with my laptop?
answer: Please bring the charger/power adapter if the issue is power-related, and back up important files beforehand.
